commands.name: init
commands.does: ask questions, write the profile, render templates, vendor the CLI

commands.name: upgrade
commands.does: re-vendor the CLI from the installed plugin

commands.name: index
commands.does: regenerate every index.md in the bundle

commands.name: check
commands.does: OKF validation, plan lint, profile lint

commands.name: status
commands.does: print the state table

commands.name: next
commands.does: print the single next action

commands.name: lane
commands.does: print the computed lane and why

commands.name: card
commands.does: render the unit card

commands.name: start
commands.does: name the worktree branch unit/U-<n> and check its base

commands.name: reserve
commands.does: next free number for a reservation

commands.name: approve
commands.does: stamp approval (owner only)

commands.name: review
commands.does: store a reviewer verdict keyed by diff hash

commands.name: report
commands.does: store the builder's report (JSON on stdin)

commands.name: hold
commands.does: record an owner hold in the plan

commands.name: priority
commands.does: record an owner priority in the plan

commands.name: fix
commands.does: create a one-unit plan without an intent

commands.name: push
commands.does: push the base after checking its new commits

commands.name: clean
commands.does: remove orphan worktrees and branches

commands.name: merge
commands.does: run the merge gate, then merge --no-ff with trailers

commands.name: hook
commands.does: entry point for hooks; reads the hook JSON on stdin

messages.unionNotList: {{layer}}: {{key}} must be a list; a {{union}} from an earlier layer cannot be removed
messages.unionReplaced: {{layer}}: {{key}} replaces an object holding a {{union}} from an earlier layer
messages.strayEnd: {{file}}: end of each block without a start
messages.indexFrontmatter: index.md may carry frontmatter only at the bundle root, with only {{keys}}
messages.indexLine: not a heading or a * [Title](url) - description entry
messages.logFrontmatter: log.md frontmatter is not a valid YAML mapping
messages.indexStale: index differs from what aidlc index generates
messages.ruleFixed: docs.rules.{{code}}: spec codes cannot be changed
messages.ruleLevel: docs.rules.{{code}}: level must be error, warning or off
messages.yamlKey: line {{line}}: expected a key: value pair
messages.yamlColon: line {{line}}: mapping values are not allowed here
messages.yamlTrailing: line {{line}}: unexpected text after a value
messages.depUnknown: {{unit}} depends on {{dep}}, which does not exist
messages.reserveKind: reservation kind {{kind}} is not in profile.reserve
messages.scopeOverlap: {{unit}} scope {{glob}} overlaps {{other}} scope {{otherGlob}} with no depends path between them
messages.laneStandard: {{item}} is outside lanes.quick and overlaps no full or focus glob
messages.noEmail: git config user.email is not set
messages.notApprovable: {{name}} is not an intent, unit or decision doc
messages.nextContinueMerge: finish the merge of {{unit}}: aidlc merge {{unit}}, or git merge --abort
messages.nextReapprove: re-approve {{docs}} after their edits: ! aidlc approve {{docs}}
messages.nextNoIntent: elaborate an intent with the owner in {{dir}}/I-1-<slug>.md, then ask for approval
messages.nextApproveIntent: ask the owner to approve {{intent}}: ! aidlc approve {{intent}}
messages.nextDraftUnits: draft the units of {{intent}} in {{dir}}/U-<n>-<slug>.md, then ask for the plan approval
messages.nextApprovePlan: ask the owner to approve the plan: ! aidlc approve {{units}}
messages.nextFixRound: fix round for {{unit}}: builder (card: aidlc card {{unit}})
messages.nextRestart: restart the builder of {{unit}} from branch {{branch}} (card: aidlc card {{unit}})
messages.nextHeld: {{units}} on hold: the owner releases them
messages.nextRelease: {{intent}} is merged: release with the owner
messages.nextIdle: all intents released: elaborate the next intent with the owner
messages.cardRefused: {{unit}} is {{state}}: the owner approves it before a card is rendered
messages.cardTooLong: card for {{unit}} is {{size}} chars, over {{max}}: shorten the unit doc
messages.modelFix: fix round after a CONFIRMED finding
messages.notWorktree: start runs in a builder's worktree, not the main checkout
messages.noCard: no card for {{unit}}: the lead runs aidlc card {{unit}} first
messages.baseMismatch: worktree is at {{head}}, the card of {{unit}} at {{base}}: restart the builder from a fresh card
messages.branchTaken: {{branch}} is checked out in {{path}}: continue there or remove that worktree

OKF-FM.fix: give the file a terminated --- block of YAML key: value pairs

OKF-TYPE.fix: add a non-empty type: to the frontmatter

HOUSE-DESC.fix: add title: and a one-sentence description:

HOUSE-LINK.fix: point the link at an existing file or remove it

HOUSE-SIZE.fix: split the doc or move detail into linked docs

PROFILE-RULE.fix: set docs.rules entries to a HOUSE-* code and one of error, warning, off

PLAN-DAG.fix: remove the cycle or point depends at an existing unit

PLAN-AC.fix: give each AC in the unit its own AC-<k>

PLAN-LEVEL.fix: write - AC-<k> (<level>): with a level from profile.levels

PLAN-RESERVE.fix: use <kind> <area>/<n> with a kind from profile.reserve and a number no other unit holds

PLAN-SCOPE.fix: give the unit a scope, narrow the scopes, or add a depends between the units
